description: This file declares functions, macros, and external variables related to managing and handling sparse indices within a version control system, likely Git. It includes functions for converting index states to sparse or full representations, expanding to specific paths, and configuring sparse index behavior.

methods.name: is_sparse_index_allowed
methods.description: Checks if sparse index is permitted given the current index state and flags.

methods.name: convert_to_sparse
methods.description: Converts an index to a sparse representation based on provided flags.

methods.name: ensure_correct_sparsity
methods.description: Ensures the index has the correct sparsity settings.

methods.name: clear_skip_worktree_from_present_files
methods.description: Clears skip worktree flags for present files in the index.

methods.name: expand_to_path
methods.description: Expands the index to include entries under a specific path, potentially outside the sparse-checkout definition.

methods.name: set_sparse_index_config
methods.description: Configures the sparse index setting for a repository.

methods.name: expand_index
methods.description: Expands the index based on pattern list, possibly full or sparse expansion.

methods.name: ensure_full_index
methods.description: Expands the index to a full index, including all entries.
